results.title: 小鹏MONA L03上市即交付，8月将启动大规模交付_车评网
results.snippet:
根据官方信息，小鹏MONA L03已于近期开启交付，该车于今年7月16日正式上市，推出9款配置，售价区间为12.38万至15.68万元。为吸引消费者，厂商提供了高达价值超过43000元的购车权益，适用于明年8月31日前下定用户。同时，官方透露，L03的大批量交付将从8月起进入全面提速阶段。
 回顾新车特点，小鹏MONA L03采用家族式设计，纯电版车型配备了102升前备厢。车身尺寸长宽高分别为4650毫米、1920毫米和1600毫米，轴距达到2850毫米，风阻系数低至0.228。消费者可选六种车身颜色:尤加利灰、星暮紫、极光紫、乌梅子酱、暗夜黑和新月银。
 “车内配置是这款车的一大亮点，”车辆内部装备了15.6英寸2.5K超高清中控大屏和26.8英寸W-HUD抬头显示系统，搭载天玑AIOS 6.2.0座舱系统。此外，该车最高可选配两颗图灵AI芯片，算力可达1500 TOPS，驾驶辅助系统支持第二代VLA技术，能够实现车位到车位行驶、无导航漫游和人机共驾功能。
动力方面，小鹏MONA L03提供超级增程和纯电两种版本。增程版搭载1.5升增程器，最大功率70千瓦，单驱动电机峰值功率183千瓦，0-100公里/小时加速时间为6.8秒。匹配37.2千瓦时电池后，CLTC纯电续航达315公里，综合续航达1330公里。纯电版则搭载183千瓦驱动电机，0-100公里/小时加速时间为6.6秒，提供56千瓦时和69千瓦时两种电池包，对应CLTC续航分别为525公里和625公里。

results.title: 小鹏汽车:MONA L03首批车主正式交车_IT之家
results.snippet:
IT之家 7 月 22 日消息，小鹏汽车今日宣布，小鹏 MONA L03 首批车主正式交车。小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏亲手为车主们递上钥匙。
官方表示，工厂正在加班加点全力排产，全国大批量交付也将在 8 月全面提速。
 据IT之家此前报道，小鹏 MONA L03 于 7 月 16 日正式上市，分为纯电、增程版本，售价 12.38 万元起。新车上市 7 分钟大定突破 2 万台，上市 1 小时大定 46859 台。
 小鹏汽车官方上周末表示，MONA L03 单日试驾量创小鹏历史车型上市同期新高，同时随着 MONA L03 的试驾量暴增也带动了小鹏全系车型的试驾量创历史新高。
MONA L03 尺寸为 4650/4672 x 1920 x 1600mm，轴距 2850mm;纯电版提供 525km、625km 两种 CLTC 续航，超级增程版 CLTC 纯电续航 315km，综合续航 1330/1380km。

results.title: XPENG MONA M03 Ultra SE, Starts Early Deliveries
results.snippet:
XPENG
XPENG MONA M03 Ultra SE, Starts Early Deliveries
Edited by Greg From Gasgoo|July 27 , 2026 23:11 BJT
Gasgoo Munich-On July 24 that XPENG founder He Xiaopeng took to Weibo to announce that deliveries of the MONA M03 Ultra SE will begin next week. The timeline has been pulled forward from August to late July — nearly a month ahead of schedule.
"Since the launch in April, our inbox has been flooded with messages from XPENG owners eager for delivery," He said. "Over the past few months, our entire project team and supply chain partners have been working around the clock on production, testing, and validation. We’ve managed to get these cars into your hands early without compromising on safety or quality." Image source: XPENG
As the top-of-the-line variant of the 2026 MONA M03, the Ultra SE debuted on April 2 alongside XPENG’s first event following its rebrand to "XPENG Group." It features two in-house Turing AI chips delivering 1500 TOPS of effective computing power and runs a fully enabled second-generation VLA (Vision-Language-Action) large model for the physical world. He emphasized that this marks the industry’s first move to bring 1500 TOPS of computing power to the 150,000 RMB price segment.
On the intelligent driving front, the Ultra SE supports full-scenario advanced features, including city and highway NOA, door-to-door autonomy, and automated parking. During the launch event, He noted that this level of computing power "surpasses many models on the market equipped with intelligent driver assistance — including several flagship vehicles priced around 500,000 RMB."
According to Yang Guang, head of the MONA product line, the Ultra SE was the result of a "rapid product adjustment." The project team initially believed the Max version would suffice, but internal testing revealed the second-generation VLA’s impressive capabilities in complex scenarios like navigating narrow alleys. That prompted the decision to add the SE variant.

results.title: XPeng MONA L03 Core Component Suppliers and Tech Specs Revealed
results.snippet: The vehicle is equipped with XPeng’s self-developed Turing AI chip and the second-generation Vision-Language-Action (VLA) large model, and is scheduled for sales in 65 countries and regions in 2026. The all-electric version features an electric motor supplied by Luxshare Intelligent Manufacturing, with a rated power of 70 kW and peak power of 183 kW. It uses CATL’s lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery packs with capacities of either 56 kWh or 69 kWh. Depending on the configuration, CLTC range figures are 550 km / 650 km for the Plus trim and 525 km / 625 km for the Max and Ultra SE trims. The lowest combined energy consumption is 11.9 kWh per 100 km, and the fastest 0–100 km/h acceleration time is 6.6 seconds. DC fast charging from 10% to 80% takes as little as approximately 19.1 minutes. The super extended-range variant is powered by a 1.5L four-cylinder range extender supplied by Chongqing Sokon Power, delivering a maximum output of 70 kW, paired with a 37.2 kWh LFP battery. It offers a CLTC pure-electric range of 315 km and a combined range of up to 1,380 km, with a WLTC fuel consumption of 5.16 L/100 km under depleted-battery conditions. In terms of intelligent driving, the Max trim is equipped with a single Turing AI chip offering an effective computing power of 750 TOPS, while the Ultra SE trim features dual chips delivering 1,500 TOPS. The software runs the second-generation VLA large model and supports OTA delivery of distilled versions to enhance urban driving assistance capabilities. The intelligent cockpit includes a 15.6-inch 2.5K central display from Tianma Microelectronics, a 26.8-inch W-HUD from Desay Multimedia, a 20-speaker AI audio system, and a dual active noise cancellation system—all powered by MediaTek’s MT8676 chip running the Dimensity AIOS operating system. On the intelligent driving front, the Ultra SE supports full-scenario advanced features, including city and highway NOA, door-to-door autonomy, and automated parking. The project team initially believed the Max version would suffice, but internal testing revealed the second-generation VLA’s impressive capabilities in complex scenarios like navigating narrow alleys. Snippet.Text: The vehicle is equipped with XPeng’s self-developed Turing AI chip and the second-generation Vision-Language-Action (VLA) large model, and is scheduled for sales in 65 countries and regions in 2026. The all-electric version features an electric motor supplied by Luxshare Intelligent Manufacturing, with a rated power of 70 kW and peak power of 183 kW. It uses CATL’s lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery packs with capacities of either 56 kWh or 69 kWh. Depending on the configuration, CLTC range figures are 550 km / 650 km for the Plus trim and 525 km / 625 km for the Max and Ultra SE trims. The lowest combined energy consumption is 11.9 kWh per 100 km, and the fastest 0–100 km/h acceleration time is 6.6 seconds. DC fast charging from 10% to 80% takes as little as approximately 19.1 minutes. The super extended-range variant is powered by a 1.5L four-cylinder range extender supplied by Chongqing Sokon Power, delivering a maximum output of 70 kW, paired with a 37.2 kWh LFP battery. It offers a CLTC pure-electric range of 315 km and a combined range of up to 1,380 km, with a WLTC fuel consumption of 5.16 L/100 km under depleted-battery conditions. In terms of intelligent driving, the Max trim is equipped with a single Turing AI chip offering an effective computing power of 750 TOPS, while the Ultra SE trim features dual chips delivering 1,500 TOPS. The software runs the second-generation VLA large model and supports OTA delivery of distilled versions to enhance urban driving assistance capabilities. The intelligent cockpit includes a 15.6-inch 2.5K central display from Tianma Microelectronics, a 26.8-inch W-HUD from Desay Multimedia, a 20-speaker AI audio system, and a dual active noise cancellation system—all powered by MediaTek’s MT8676 chip running the Dimensity AIOS operating system.
